summary: All 7 acceptance criteria exercised: 1 backend test file + 6 browser checks, all passing.

checks.criterion: Premium editorial homepage covers the requested discovery and trust content
checks.name: homepage-editorial-sections-visible
checks.evidence: Mobile viewport: hero, craft-heritage-bar, shop-by-category, new-arrivals, best-sellers, extended-sizes, fabric section, craft story, customer-care-integrity, Instagram journal and WhatsApp CTA all visible; body text contains no fabricated ratings/urgency phrases.

checks.criterion: Navigation, search and product discovery are usable
checks.name: navigation-search-and-shop-filters
checks.evidence: Mobile menu opens/closes, header search routes to /shop with results, category filter narrows to 2 items (verified against GET /api/products?category=Anarkali Sets -> 2), sort=price-low applied, clear-filters restores full 6-item catalog after awaiting the refetch response.

checks.criterion: Product page supports a persuasive purchase decision
checks.name: product-page-purchase-decision-details
checks.evidence: Gallery, price, three detail accordions (fabric/craft/fit, measurements/transparency/lining, care/availability/dispatch) visible; size + colour selection, size guide modal open/close, wishlist toggle (is-saved class), Add to Bag opens cart-drawer, sticky-mobile-add-to-cart visible, WhatsApp href contains wa.me, and Complete-the-Look/related/more-from-collection/more-from-fabric links all present.

checks.criterion: Wishlist and cart journey works end to end
checks.name: wishlist-and-cart-journey
checks.evidence: Saved product from shop grid appears on /wishlist by title; quick-add opens cart drawer; quantity increase updates cart-quantity span to 2; View Cart opens /cart showing the same item and a computed summary total; remove empties the cart to the large empty-state.

checks.criterion: Recommendations and contextual assistance are present
checks.name: product-page-purchase-decision-details
checks.evidence: Same check as above also asserts related-shop-link, more-from-collection-link, more-from-fabric-link and complete-look section visibility, plus WhatsApp href containing wa.me with contextual product text.

checks.name: admin-catalog-add-edit-delete-product
checks.evidence: Created tscheck-admin-ui-<ts> via /admin form (size/color/description/stock fields), row appeared with '7 total stock'; edited stock to 15 and row updated to '15 total stock'; deleted the row and confirmed 0 matching rows remain.

checks.name: test_admin_can_create_update_and_delete_product
checks.evidence: POST /api/products -> 201/200 created tscheck-admin-product-<hex>; GET /api/products includes it; PATCH /api/products/{id} -> 200 with stock=12 and updated description, confirmed via GET single product; DELETE /api/products/{id} -> 200/204, confirmed removed from subsequent GET /api/products list.

checks.name: public-deployment-health
checks.evidence: Ran against https://lucknowi-craft.preview.emergentagent.com: homepage, /shop, /product/{id} navigations all render with no HTTP >=400 responses observed; GET /api/products returned 200 with 6 seeded products.
